insight: A Y Combinator (S21) startup; raised an $18M Series A led by Scale and Sequoia to build conversational video AI.
name: Tavus
tagline: Real-time conversational video AI and digital human replicas.
description: A developer platform for building face-to-face AI agents that see, listen, and respond in live video through its Conversational Video Interface (CVI). It also generates personalized videos at scale from digital replicas of a real person. Built on Tavus's own models — Phoenix for rendering, Raven for perception, and Sparrow for conversational timing — with the ability to plug in custom LLMs and text-to-speech.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own Phoenix/Raven/Sparrow models; CVI lets you bring a custom LLM and TTS.

edge: Runs on its own render/perception/timing models (Phoenix, Raven, Sparrow) with sub-500ms turn-taking, yet still lets you bring a custom LLM and TTS.
pros: Plug in custom LLM and TTS
